scene_description: A group of children and an adult sitting around a campfire in the woods, roasting marshmallows on sticks. A green tent and blue camping chairs are visible in the background.

questions.question: What are the children holding over the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the children are holding out toward the fire.

questions.question: What is in the middle of the group?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round metal bowl in the center of the picture.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tall trees behind the people.

questions.question: Who is sitting in the chairs around the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people sitting around the fire.

questions.question: What is set up behind the people?
questions.evidence_hint: Look behind the people at the green shape in the background.
